title: Is Adaptive SBRT for Prostate vs Image-guided Radiotherapy a True Evolution (ASPIRE)
eligibility:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Age \>18 years
2. Histologic diagnosis of prostate adenocarcinoma
3. Localized prostate cancer
4. Low risk, intermediate risk, or high risk allowed
5. Patient planned for prostate SBRT

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Planned for elective nodal irradiation
2. Contraindications to radiotherapy
3. Patients with bilateral hip replacements, as they are ineligible for adaptive treatments at present time (either MR-guided or CT-guided)
